checks.name: same game and target, both campaigns passed
same production budgets and exact game assets
same complete initial public packet hash
same physical commands, full animation packet hashes and primitive boundaries
same selected source prefix kinds and acquired action counts
same previously reported series projection with observation-scope normalization
new program projections remain empty in these regression games
same request outcomes and common caller revisions
same final public result and retained-session counters
source frozen during both campaigns and no Python agent modules

qualification: Compares public behavior, source prefix descriptions, acquisition counters and all previously reported series projections, including cell models. Only observation session scope is normalized within those projections. Native graph chains/revisions and the expanded shared inherited digest/scope are not compared. The newly reported program projections must independently remain empty for these regression games. Timings are excluded; this is not a speed comparison or full internal-state parity.
